slides.title: The washing day
slides.body:
*Lördag* goes back to Old Norse _laugardagr_, which means washing day or bath day.

English went another way: Saturday is named after the Roman god Saturn.

slides.title: And the rest of the week

caption:
Lördag, Swedish for Saturday, comes from an Old Norse word for washing day.

Most of the other weekdays are named after the moon and Norse gods, just like in English: onsdag is Odin's day and torsdag is Thor's day.

Which day of the week is your favourite?
